title: vibecheck session status (v1)
description: One file per live agent session, written by an agent integration and read by the vibecheck app. Agent-neutral: nothing here is specific to any one agent.

pid.description: PID of the long-lived agent process. The app drops the session once this process exits. Omit only if unknown; the app then falls back to an updatedAt staleness timeout.

origin.description: Which app the session runs in, so the app can bring it forward. Optional; the app prefers walking the process tree from pid and uses this when the tree is broken (e.g. tmux).

bundleId.description: Bundle id of the launching app (__CFBundleIdentifier), e.g. com.googlecode.iterm2, com.t3tools.t3code.

termProgram.description: TERM_PROGRAM, e.g. Apple_Terminal, iTerm.app, ghostty, WezTerm, vscode.

status.description: working: agent is busy. needs_attention: agent is waiting on the user. idle: finished, waiting for the next prompt. blocked: stopped by a usage or rate limit. error: last run failed.

task.description: What the session is working on, usually the latest user prompt.

activity.description: Short, live description of the current step.

questions.description: Optional structured questions, shown with their options when the panel opens.
